title: Clear stale grant fields in the target returned after ensure rebinds a session
outcome: Clear stale grant fields in the target returned after ensure rebinds a session
acceptance: After ensure successfully rebinds a session whose canonical grant was cleared, its returned target active and uncertain grant fields match canonical session state, consistent with the existing status-recovery convention.
A regression checks both canonical state and returned target after invalid-token reconciliation, while preserving existing same-key and ownership behavior.
